fixed_source_defaults.directionalThreshold: 2 times mean true range of20 completed bars ending immediately before current; held constant for the entire128-close reconstruction
fixed_source_defaults.pathQuotes: completed closes only; no inference of intrabar high/low order
fixed_source_defaults.initialization: unknown direction with running min/max; first inclusive threshold crossing determines direction and starting pivot
fixed_source_defaults.confirmation: one reversal per completed close, inclusive distance>=threshold from running directional extreme
fixed_source_defaults.completedLeg: previous pivot extreme to new extreme; overshoot=max(amplitude-threshold,0); duration=extremeIndex-pivotIndex, no confirmation-delay bars in duration
fixed_source_defaults.event: a reversal into declared direction is confirmed on the current bar, not a historical event
fixed_source_defaults.history: last two fully completed positive and negative legs required; all duration>0
fixed_source_defaults.dominance: sum of two same-direction overshoot/duration strictly >1.25 times sum of two opposite-direction rates, using exact rational cross-products
fixed_source_defaults.strength: each of the two same-direction overshoots >=threshold/2; latest opposite leg overshoot <= mean of those two
fixed_source_defaults.currentBar: positive volume and body in declared direction; all visible OHLC valid and volume nonnegative
fixed_source_defaults.risk: ATR14 current stop1.5 and take3; explicit unchanged ATR20 EMS protection, firstStep>=0.5percent
fixed_source_defaults.parameters: none; long/short share one conservative mechanism group
fixed_source_defaults.invalidInput: reject malformed OHLC, negative volume, nonpositive threshold, zero-duration legs; no epsilon or future pivot confirmation

research_caveat: Finite rolling reconstruction, NOT an unlimited stateful directional-change history. Existing kernel analogue and breakout-event-duration predictors are not new mechanisms to rename: this policy has no forecast labels, kernel, breakout-count clock or refit. Swing/turning exposure remains; names and engineering parity do not prove financial edge or economic independence. Financial history of other policies has been inspected; preserve every negative result and all original gates.
